g.text: Ingestion and Normalization Service [Java / Spring Boot]

a.xlink:title: 01: Starts GitHub sign-in with consent and exchanges the handoff for a session (REST/HTTPS)
06: Requests verified user access and workflow metadata (REST/HTTPS)
02: Exchanges the sign-in code with the PKCE verifier (OAuth/HTTPS)
03: Signs session tokens and keeps PKCE verifiers in custody (Azure Key Vault API/HTTPS)
04: Persists login attempts and consent records (PostgreSQL)
07: Verifies identity, installations, repository access and collaborators (REST/HTTPS)
08: Keeps user tokens in custody (Azure Key Vault API/HTTPS)
